verses.commentary: Woe to you complacent in Zion. Both kingdoms addressed: Zion (Judah) and Samaria (Israel). Notable men of the foremost nation. The elite, the comfortable, the important. Security breeds blindness.
Go to Kalneh, Hamath, Gath. Great cities now fallen or diminished. Are they better than you? Is their land larger? If those powers fell, why assume you are safe?
You put off the day of disaster. Denial as strategy. But in doing so, you bring near a reign of terror. Postponing thought of judgment accelerates its arrival. Denial is not prevention.
You lie on beds of ivory. Luxury furniture, inlaid decoration. Lounging on couches, dining on choice lamb and fatted calf. The best food, the finest rest. Self-indulgence detailed.
You strum on harps like David. They fancy themselves artists, musicians. Improvising on instruments. But David wrote psalms of repentance; they write songs of self-congratulation.

You drink wine by the bowlful. Not cups but bowls. Excess upon excess. Finest lotions for the body. But you do not grieve over the ruin of Joseph. No concern for the nation's spiritual collapse. Self-care without community care.
Therefore you will be first to go into exile. First in luxury, first in captivity. Feasting and lounging will end. The party stops. Those who led in indulgence lead the march to Assyria.

The Lord swears by himself. Since there is none greater, God swears by his own being. I abhor Jacob's pride, detest his fortresses. Pride and military confidence equally offensive. City and contents delivered up.
If ten people remain in one house, they too will die. Even survivors die. No critical mass ensures survival. The count keeps shrinking.

A relative comes to burn the bodies. Cremation unusual in Israel but necessary in plague or siege. Is anyone with you? No. Hush! We must not mention the Lord's name. Fear that invoking God might bring more judgment. Silence born of terror.
The Lord has given the command. Divine decree behind human destruction. Great house and small house both shattered. No economic class escapes. Wealth provides no shelter.

Do horses run on rocky crags? Does one plow the sea with oxen? Absurd questions. But you have turned justice into poison. Making justice toxic is equally absurd, equally unnatural. Righteousness into bitterness.

You rejoice in Lo Debar (which means nothing). You boast of taking Karnaim (horns, symbol of power) by your own strength. Celebrating conquests that are actually empty. Finding significance in insignificance.

I will stir up a nation against you. Assyria again, unnamed but certain. Oppression from Lebo Hamath (northern border) to the valley of Arabah (southern). The entire nation squeezed. What they did to others, done to them.
